moments.title: "There's no way jobs will not be lost"
moments.insight: Vitali argues this industrial revolution is compressed into one generation, making mid-career retraining unrealistic for many workers.

moments.title: The 20% unemployment fascism warning
moments.insight: History shows societies hitting 20% unemployment tend toward fascism, citing Goldman Sachs projections and Weimar Germany's collapse.

moments.title: Moore's Law for AI is now just 6 months
moments.insight: AI/robotics capability is doubling every 6 months, far outpacing aging legislators' ability to craft guardrails in time.

moments.title: A Soviet refugee's verdict on utopian AI dreams
moments.insight: Having grown up in the USSR, Vitali argues true post-work utopia doesn't work in practice—human nature always finds workarounds.

moments.title: Connecting economic displacement to political extremism
moments.insight: He traces a direct line from job loss and lost community to political entrepreneurs exploiting grievance, invoking troubling Nazi-era parallels.

moments.title: Why he's bearish on humanoid robots at home
moments.insight: A 150-200lb robot walking around kids and pets isn't safe yet, and most people won't pay $20,000 for an unclear use case.
